mapper.insert: insert into item( title, description, category_id, user_id, cover_bucket, cover_object_key, file_bucket, file_object_key, cover_url, file_url, tags, extra_data ) values( #{title}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{userId}, #{coverBucket}, #{coverObjectKey}, #{fileBucket}, #{fileObjectKey}, #{coverUrl}, #{fileUrl}, #{tags}, #{extraData} )
mapper.update:
update item set title=#{title}, description=#{description}, category_id=#{categoryId}, user_id=#{userId}, cover_bucket=#{coverBucket}, cover_object_key=#{coverObjectKey}, cover_url=#{coverUrl}, file_url=#{fileUrl}, file_bucket=#{fileBucket}, file_object_key=#{fileObjectKey}, tags=#{tags}, extra_data=#{extraData}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, title, description, category_id as categoryId, user_id as userId, cover_bucket as coverBucket, cover_object_key as coverObjectKey, file_bucket as fileBucket, file_object_key as fileObjectKey, tags, extra_data as extraData, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from item order by id desc

select i.id, i.title, i.description, i.cover_url as coverUrl, i.cover_bucket as coverBucket, i.cover_object_key as coverObjectKey, i.file_url as fileUrl, i.file_bucket as fileBucket, i.file_object_key as fileObjectKey, i.tags, i.extra_data as extraData, i.user_id as userId, u.real_name as userRealName, i.create_time as createTime, i.update_time as updateTime,
c.id as "category.id", c.name as "category.name", c.icon_object_key as "category.iconObjectKey", c.icon_bucket as "category.iconBucket", c.description as "category.description", c.create_time as "category.createTime", c.update_time as "category.updateTime",
(select count(*) from favorite f where f.item_id = i.id) as favorites,
(select count(*) from user_action ua where ua.item_id = i.id and ua.action_type = 0) as views from item i
left join category c on i.category_id = c.id
left join user u on i.user_id = u.id
i.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and i.category_id = #{categoryId}
and u.real_name like concat('%', #{userRealName}, '%')
and i.tags like concat('%', #{tag}, '%')
order by i.id desc
